desc: The littoral combat ship whose combat information center recorded four transmedium tic-tac-shaped objects in Warning Area W-291 off Southern California at approximately 1915 PST on 15 February 2023, using a Star SAFIRE multi-spectral electro-optical/infrared system. Senior Chief Operations Specialist Alexandro Wiggins testified to the House Oversight Task Force on 9 September 2025 that the footage carries 'timestamps, lat/long, and platform readouts consistent with USS Jackson's location' - metadata of exactly the kind the NASA Independent Study Team said the government's UAP holdings lack. The ship is significant to the board because of the disclosure path, not just the sighting: the recording reached the public through journalists, and the crew member carried it to Congress himself while still on active duty. No AARO case assessment of the Jackson footage has been published, and it is not identifiable in any released annual report.
